findings.description: Refunder.refunds (dataset/contracts/c09.sol#6) is never initialized. It is used in:
Refunder.refundAll() (dataset/contracts/c09.sol#13-17) has external calls inside a loop: require(bool)(refundAddresses[x].send(refunds[refundAddresses[x]])) (dataset/contracts/c09.sol#15)
solc-0.4.24 is an outdated solc version. Use a more recent version (at least 0.8.0), if possible.
Version constraint 0.4.24 contains known severe issues (https://solidity.readthedocs.io/en/latest/bugs.html)
Loop condition x < refundAddresses.length (dataset/contracts/c09.sol#14) should use cached array length instead of referencing `length` member of the storage array.
